## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets or service-role keys added
- [ ] New tables have row level security policies
- [ ] Privileged writes go through a role-checked, audited database function
